content_units: This is the cleanest 90-minute slot inside your allowed window. It avoids lunch, ends before the engineer’s 10:30–11:15 conflict, and stays well before the designer’s 2:00–4:00 PM unavailability.
Recommended Schedule and Why It Wins
Recommended   09:00–10:30   Best   Fully clear for all attendees; starts the day with alignment
Backup 1   11:15–12:45   Not ideal   Overlaps lunch from 12:00–12:45
Backup 2   13:00–14:30   Not ideal   Overlaps designer conflict from 14:00–14:30
Backup 3   11:15–12:00 + split follow-up   Poor   Breaks the required 90-minute continuous session
- No overlap with lunch or stated conflicts.
- Gives the team the rest of the day to start follow-up actions.
- Best fit for a kickoff, where energy and decision speed usually matter.
-   09:10–09:25   — Product overview: problem, users, and business context
-   09:25–09:45   — Scope review: what is in, what is out, and key milestones
-   09:45–10:05   — Roles and collaboration model across manager, engineering, and design
-   10:20–10:30   — Decisions recap, owners, and next steps
- Send meeting notes and decision summary within the same day
- Confirm project goal, scope boundaries, and success metrics
- Assign owners for engineering, design, and delivery coordination
- Create or update the project brief and shared workspace
- Log risks, assumptions, and dependencies in one visible tracker
- Break next steps into action items with due dates
- Schedule the next checkpoint meeting before the week ends
headings: Recommended Schedule and Why It Wins
